tadlis.source: Ibn Hajar, Tabaqat al-Mudallisin, rank 3, no. 102, https://shamela.ws/book/1186/43
tadlis.note: «الفقيه المدني نزيل الشام، مشهور بالإمامة والجلالة من التابعين، وصفه الشافعي والدارقطني وغير واحد بالتدليس». Rank 3: those who used the ambiguous formula so often that the imams relied only on what they stated they heard. Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Qattan counted al-Zuhri's mursal reports as worth nothing (Tahdhib al-Tahdhib 9/450).

bio: The central figure of early hadith transmission, with hundreds of students. Many different versions of this hadith are attributed to him, which is why the critics compared them so closely.
